entries.evidence: 원본: part velocities/energy/path preserved. 튜닝: shadow continuity

entries.reason: User addendum excludes armor-induced deformation and initial yaw
entries.evidence: 원본: residual speed/history and altered flight direction. 사용자 범위: no new armor-yaw/deformation

entries.before: S0 used only direct chords; nearMisses was limited2cm
entries.after: Permanent radius from projected frontal/side area. TC radius=k√(dE/dx); sparse fragment-track volume distinct from outer reach. Weighted tissueTC plus permanent/fragment volumes produce effective damage.
entries.reason: Measure heterogeneous anatomical injury along each part
entries.evidence: 출처: temporary-cavity volume/energy association in simulants and tissue qualitative order. 튜닝: square-root functional form,k,1D surface-gap/axial overlap,fragmentFillFraction and all numeric tissue ratios

M193780/M855760 are reused as unverified S1fragment thresholds, with original semantics disclosed. Frozen114cartridge map supplies original effective diameter; donor length scales with diameter as tuning. entries.reason: Fackler calibrated axial curve; no invented primary-paper threshold

entries.before: S0/retained original physiological severity and monitor-only organ fields were not local cavity-volume fractions
entries.after: Organ severity=clamp(effectiveVolume/shapeVolume×gain); regenerate all injury effects and aggregate profiles from severity. Actual direct and modeledTC/fragment damage remain distinguished; no fake internalHits.
entries.reason: Make new anatomy volume input reach real medical consumers

entries.after: Retain actual direct brain/brainstem and bone/spinal rules. TC-only brain continuously caps target by modeled severity, does not invoke direct CNS shortcut. TC-only spinal remains record-only; noTC fracture.
entries.reason: Avoid treating a modeled cavity as a direct bullet intersection
entries.evidence: 원본/S0: direct rules. 튜닝: continuousTCbrain target. 사용자범위: noTCfracture

limitations: M855 curve is M193 donor; no dedicated M855 source profile.
Primary-paper numeric fragmentation thresholds unverified; legacy780/760 reused with changed semantic meaning as tuning.
Pistol source has30cm composite lower bound only; model stop/TC numeric reference is entirely estimated tuning.
Multiple lobes are visible for AK74/AK47; final secondary-lobe fit must be reported, not hidden by matching the global peak alone.
Cd/k are fitted homogeneous-material coefficients; predictedexit/stop is shadow-only and cannot replace actualbodyresistance.
Organ volumes/surface-gap overlap are geometric1D approximations, not measured clinical injury volumes.
LUT depth interpolation changes three small positive boundary organ-overlap IDs in1000actualinputs; do not call identical to direct integration. Actual flight/bodyexit unchanged.

Separate real browser face-jaw trajectory, with no directbrain/brainstem intersection, causesTC-driven unconsciousness/ragdoll at0.5833s(v38no collapse15s). Fixed240facebench remainsclear120s; do not generalize its criteriaPASS to allfacepaths.
